policy: Descriptive external AI evidence, frozen-label denominators. Errors are source annotations, not an exhaustive human inventory. Ineligible deliveries are abstentions, never successes. Unknown judgments remain unknown. Clean allDefectsRepaired is inapplicable: strict full success uses justified, meaningPreserved, noNewErrors and cleanPreserved; erroneous sources use allDefectsRepaired. Sound passage omits justified, keeping edit necessity separate. No critical=true passage can succeed. New-error booleans include formatting/meaning; the explicit spelling/grammar tag count is only a heterogeneous-taxonomy lower bound. Alternative lists are not independently valid-candidate counts.
